tirage.title: Rules of the “Beta testers — Import” prize draw (Mitsitsy)
tirage.metaDescription: Rules of the Beta testers prize draw for Mitsitsy's automatic import: free entry, 10 winners drawn at random.

organizer.title: 1. Organiser
organizer.content: The draw is organised by [Raymond Dzery Hago - Labs], publisher of the Mitsitsy application. Contact: [contact e-mail].

free.title: 2. Free entry
free.content: Entry is free and no purchase is necessary. Google is neither an organiser, nor a partner, nor a sponsor of this draw.

who.title: 3. Who can enter
who.content: Anyone who uses Mitsitsy version 2.2.0 or later, [aged 18 or over].

how.title: 4. How to enter
steps: Use your 3 import reads of the cycle with the “Import from a screenshot” feature (beta).
Send your feedback from the application, giving your e-mail address and agreeing to its use for the draw.
how.content: Each e-mail address gets one entry only. Feedback sent without an e-mail address is not entered in the draw.

dates.title: 5. Dates
dates.content: Entries are open from [release date of 2.2.0] to [closing date]. The draw takes place after the closing date, before the next update of the application.

prizes.title: 6. Prizes
prizes.rest: in Mitsitsy. The prize is personal. It cannot be exchanged, sold or converted into money.

winners.title: 7. Selecting and informing the winners
winners.content: The 10 winners are drawn at random from the valid entries. Each winner receives an activation code by e-mail, to be entered in the application from the update that activates this code. A winner who does not reply or whose e-mail address is invalid may be replaced by a new draw.

data.title: 8. Personal data
data.content: The e-mail address is used only for the draw and for sending the code. It is neither sold nor passed on. It is deleted [6 months] after the draw. To view or delete it, write to [contact e-mail].

changes.title: 9. Changes or cancellation
changes.content: The organiser may change, postpone or cancel the draw in the event of force majeure or fraud. In that case, participants are informed on this page.

importBeta.headline: Import your expenses from a screenshot
importBeta.subheadline: A screenshot of the MCB Juice Transactions screen, or a photo of a withdrawal, card or till receipt. Mitsitsy reads the transactions on the phone, without internet, and you check everything before saving.

pick.title: Choose a screenshot or take a photo

check.title: Check each transaction
check.description: Amount, account, category: you correct before saving.

save.title: Save everything at once
save.description: Transactions count on their real date in your budgets and reports.

tester.description: Beta testers. Do your 3 imports, give your feedback and get a chance to win unlimited import for life: 10 testers drawn at random.
